Hi Elaine — thanks for sending these over. Quick overview of what we need to move to PO issuance: 

1) COI + endorsement: we require Redwoods to be listed as Additional Insured on GL and Auto (as applicable) with the following name: "Redwood Inference, Inc., 600 3rd St, San Francisco, CA 94107".
2) Waiver of subrogation: if possible for GL/PL, please request the endorsement.
3) Vendor legal name and remit details (exact name to appear on PO, tax ID/EIN, remit address, invoice email).
4) Billing contact and invoice cadence (monthly/one-time).

If the endorsement will take >5 business days we can provision a conditional PO for the onboarding period (limited value) so ClearSync can begin work while the broker issues the endorsement. Procurement (Marissa) and Legal (Karthik) are looped for timing and acceptance criteria.

Thanks — feel free to upload the endorsement to the Drive link below or reply with the updated COI.
https://drive.redwood.com/s/clearsync/insurance-ctl

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference

Hi Elaine — thanks for the files. To accelerate PO creation, please provide the following in a single reply or via the vendor setup form attached: 

- Legal company name exactly as it should appear on the PO
- W-9/EIN (youve attached this, confirmed)
- Remit-to address and preferred invoice email
- Preferred payment method (ACH/wire/check) and account details if you want wires enabled (we can add w/o storing bank details in the initial setup; will require an additional vendor form)
- Any reseller/subcontractor disclosure (if ClearSync will route work to subcontractors)

Ive attached the Redwood Vendor Setup template (Vendor_Setup_Form_Template.docx) — filling it will cut back-and-forth. Once we have the endorsement and completed form, I can create the PO. Typical timeline: endorsement + completed form -> PO created within 2 business days.

If you prefer an interim acceptance, reply and we can issue a conditional PO (value limited to $10k) while you obtain the endorsement.
